column1: # The book's record twice a day (webapp.roi_log): slot (UTC date and 00/12 half),
# when it was written, settled bets, hits (pushes as hits), hit rate, staked EUR,
# ROI on stake — the numbers the top tiles print.
# Rows marked 'backfill' (written 1 Oct) are rebuilt from the ledger:
# each settled bet counted from its kickoff + 2 hours, the record taken
# as the slot opens. Cash-outs settled earlier in reality; close enough.
